description:
**Procurement & Vendor Management Executive**

**Department:** Operations / Administration  
**Industry:** Education / School Operations  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** [Add Location]

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an organised and proactive Procurement & Vendor Management Executive to manage purchasing activities, vendor coordination, inventory requirements, and procurement documentation for a school.

The candidate will be responsible for sourcing quality materials and services, comparing quotations, negotiating with vendors, monitoring deliveries, and ensuring cost-effective procurement. The role requires strong coordination, follow-up, negotiation, and documentation skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end purchasing activities, from collecting requirements to ensuring timely delivery.
* Source school supplies, stationery, furniture, IT equipment, maintenance materials, housekeeping supplies, and event-related items.
* Obtain and compare vendor quotations based on pricing, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Negotiate prices, payment terms, and delivery schedules with vendors.
* Prepare purchase orders and maintain records of quotations, invoices, and procurement transactions.
* Develop and maintain relationships with vendors and service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance and resolve delivery delays, quality issues, and other procurement-related concerns.
* Coordinate with school administration, academic teams, IT, facilities, and finance departments to fulfil requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate stock replenishment to prevent shortages.
* Track procurement expenses and ensure purchases follow approved budgets and internal procedures.
* Maintain updated vendor databases and procurement documentation.
* Coordinate purchasing requirements for school events, examinations, workshops, sports activities, and other school programs.

**Required Skills**

* Vendor management and negotiation
* Procurement and purchase coordination
* Quotation comparison and cost analysis
* Purchase order and invoice documentation
* Inventory and stock coordination
* Communication and follow-up
* MS Excel and Google Sheets
* Organisation, time management, and problem-solving

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in procurement, purchasing, vendor management, administration, or operations.
* Experience in education, hospitality, facilities management, or a corporate environment is an advantage.
* Practical experience in vendor negotiations, quotation comparison, purchase orders, and delivery coordination.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, commercially aware, and dependable, with the ability to manage multiple purchasing requirements, coordinate with vendors, negotiate competitive rates, and ensure timely availability of materials and services.

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** Procurement / Purchase / Vendor Management – 3 years preferred.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: Assistant Manager, Operations
description:
Overview:

The **Municipal Lien Manager** plays a pivotal role in ensuring smooth real estate transactions by overseeing the complex processes related to municipal liens, property taxes, permits, code violations, and utilities across the US. This role requires an in-depth understanding of local government regulations and administrative structures, enabling seamless property sales and compliance with various legal requirements. As the leader of a dedicated team, you will be responsible for guiding the management of property liens, resolving lien-related issues, and ensuring accurate data retrieval from government websites. MLS Manager’s expertise will drive the efficiency of operations, support the professional growth of your team, and contribute to Rexera’s mission of transforming the real estate landscape through innovation and streamlined processes.

Responsibilities:

* **Expertise in US Administrative Structures:** Lead the team in understanding administrative frameworks across counties, cities, municipalities, towns, and townships in the US.
* **Property Tax and Lien Mastery:** Oversee the calculation and collection of property taxes, including assessment methods, payment procedures, and lien processes.
* **Lien Management:** Ensure proficient handling of property liens, including obtaining lien payoffs, clearing liens, and mitigating their impact on property sales.
* **Government Website Navigation:** Guide the team in effectively navigating government portals to retrieve crucial information on permits, code enforcement, utilities, and property taxes.
* **Stay Updated on Regulations:** Monitor changes in website layouts and content to maintain accuracy and efficiency in information retrieval.
* **Code Violations & Permits:** Manage code violations, understand their effect on property ownership, and implement strategies for resolution. Oversee the distinction between open and expired permits.
* **Utility Management:** Oversee the understanding of utility services in US homes and the billing processes for both public and private utility providers.
* **Team Leadership:** Provide guidance, mentoring, and management to the team, ensuring effective execution of tasks and continuous professional development.

Qualifications:

**Essential Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills with fluent English and an accent that is easily understood by American clients.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with government officials, property owners, and stakeholders to resolve lien-related matters.
* Proficiency in using online research tools and computer software for data collection and management.
* Exceptional organizational skills with strong problem-solving abilities.
* Detail-oriented with the capability to manage multiple tasks and projects concurrently.

**Desired Skills**

* Prior experience managing municipal lien projects or working with US property liens and local government entities.
* Knowledge of permit search, code & real estate transactions, particularly as they relate to liens and tax procedures, is a strong advantage.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Public Administration, Real Estate, Finance, or a related field.
* A minimum of 8 years of overall experience, including at least 1 year leading a municipal lien team of 5 or more members.

Part of your usual concerns include the maintenance all records related to the performance of facility management operations on the site. You’ll also find yourself developing MIS reports for our management team. And when the operations manager is not present, you’ll be expected to lead the monthly progress meeting.
  
  
Besides these, you will train team members on all quality policies and procedures. Every now and then, you’ll also be involved in reviewing the performance of our staff and conducting performance appraisals.
  
  
Bringing maximum value through excellent service deliveryBeyond daily maintenance, your ultimate focus is to provide professional, value-focused service that helps us meet—and go beyond—the client’s expectations.
  
  
Lending your business acumen, you’ll advise the client on future maintenance budgets, so you’ll need to be in tuned with the organization’s ins and outs, goals and overall direction. Your expertise in the world of contracts would be incredibly useful, as you’ll also get your hands on defining terms and conditions, operational scope and documents for annual maintenance contracts. Along with this, you’ll run successful tendering exercises that will help you find the right subcontractors. You’ll also carry out comparative analysis and make recommendations to the client on the most appropriate subcontractors.
  
  
Plus, it’s your job to develop service level agreements (SLAs) and assist our procurement experts in closing these agreements with vendors. While in the process, you’ll consider: Is the team deployed by the vendor made up of the right resources—in terms of level and scale—to deliver quality services?
  
  
Playing the role of a strategic operator, you will also craft annual cost-saving goals in energy usage and maintenance operations. Coordinating with specialist professionals to ensure compliance with minimum wage acts for payments and regulations falls into your hands as well.

Your ability to deal with clients, vendors and onsite personnel carries a huge impact on your success as facility manager. Also, you will audit subcontractors on the quality of materials and upkeep of the site.
  
  
You’ll will coordinate with the HR department and the Operations Manager and make recommendations for future trainings to be given to the site facility management team. You’ll prepare and review the preventive maintenance register on a monthly basis and update the operations manager. A balanced leader and followerAre you equipped to set up a team to success? Can you also play to your strengths and work effectively as a team member? If yes, that’s great—the ability to bring about positive changes and follow through with them will be beneficial for this role. What we can do for you:
  
  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. description:
**Company Description**

At Vroutes HR, we focus on creating coaction capabilities and empowering employers with the most precious asset-people. With a combination of innovative technology and personal touch, we have enabled marketing and advertising firms to achieve their vision. Founded in the year 2017 Vroutes HR have been striving hard to help agencies across India structure their human resources and achieve their short and long-term goals. From Staffing and Recruitment, Performance management, Training and Development, Employee Engagement, Compliance management, Payroll management, Grievances Handling, HR Strategy services and HR Audits we are a one stop solution for complete HR Solutions.

 **Job Description**

**1. Infrastructure and Property Maintenance**

* **Oversee the maintenance of all common areas, internal roads, pathways, drainage systems, streetlights, and community infrastructure.**
* **Ensure the proper functioning and upkeep of electrical systems, plumbing, water supply, pumps, DG sets, STP/WTP, and other utility installations, as applicable.**
* **Monitor the condition of buildings, amenities, equipment, and infrastructure to identify and resolve maintenance issues proactively.**
* **Plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities.**
* **Coordinate repairs, renovations, and infrastructure improvement projects.**
* **Maintain maintenance schedules, equipment records, service logs, and technical documentation.**

**2. Facility and Common Area Management**

* **Ensure the upkeep of landscaped areas, gardens, parks, clubhouses, swimming pools, gymnasiums, and other community amenities, as applicable.**
* **Monitor housekeeping, waste management, pest control, sanitation, and overall cleanliness.**
* **Ensure common facilities are maintained to premium residential community standards.**
* **Conduct regular inspections and ensure timely closure of identified maintenance issues.**
* **Coordinate with security teams to ensure smooth day-to-day community operations and appropriate access control.**

**3. Manpower and Staff Management**

* **Manage and supervise housekeeping staff, technicians, electricians, plumbers, gardeners, security personnel, and other outsourced or in-house facility staff.**
* **Allocate duties, prepare duty rosters, monitor attendance, and ensure adequate manpower availability.**
* **Monitor staff performance, productivity, discipline, grooming, and service quality.**
* **Ensure staff follow established operating procedures, safety guidelines, and service standards.**
* **Address operational issues and coordinate training wherever required.**

**4. Vendor and Contractor Management**

* **Coordinate with external vendors, contractors, and service providers for maintenance, repairs, and facility services.**
* **Monitor vendor performance, service quality, timelines, and contractual commitments.**
* **Verify completed work and ensure adherence to agreed specifications.**
* **Maintain vendor records, service agreements, warranties, and annual maintenance contracts (AMCs).**
* **Identify opportunities to improve service quality and optimise maintenance costs.**

**5. Budgeting and Cost Control**

* **Prepare and monitor facility maintenance budgets and operational expenses.**
* **Track expenditure on repairs, utilities, consumables, manpower, and vendor services.**
* **Control unnecessary costs without compromising safety or service quality.**
* **Maintain records of purchase requests, invoices, quotations, and maintenance expenses.**
* **Recommend cost-effective solutions for recurring maintenance issues and infrastructure improvements.**

**6. Safety, Compliance and Emergency Management**

* **Ensure compliance with applicable safety requirements and relevant statutory obligations for facility operations.**
* **Monitor fire safety systems, emergency exits, firefighting equipment, and emergency response arrangements.**
* **Coordinate periodic inspections, equipment testing, and emergency preparedness drills.**
* **Ensure safe working practices for employees, contractors, and service providers.**
* **Respond to emergencies such as power failures, water supply disruptions, equipment breakdowns, flooding, and other facility-related incidents.**
* **Maintain incident reports and implement corrective and preventive actions.**

**7. Resident Coordination and Service Delivery**

* **Act as the primary point of contact for facility-related concerns raised by residents, the association, or community management.**
* **Ensure complaints and service requests are recorded, prioritised, and resolved within defined timelines.**
* **Communicate maintenance schedules, planned service disruptions, and important operational updates.**
* **Maintain a professional and service-oriented approach while dealing with residents.**
* **Work closely with the Resident Welfare Association (RWA), Homeowners Association, or community management committee, as applicable.**

**8. Reporting and Documentation**

* **Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly facility operations reports.**
* **Track maintenance requests, complaint closure rates, preventive maintenance completion, and recurring issues.**
* **Maintain records of assets, equipment, maintenance schedules, vendor contracts, and utility consumption.**
* **Provide regular updates to management on facility performance, expenses, risks, and improvement initiatives.**

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* **B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.**
* **5–8 years of relevant experience in facility management, property maintenance, residential communities, hotels, commercial buildings, or integrated facilities management.**
* **Experience managing technical infrastructure, utilities, maintenance activities, and service staff.**
* **Strong knowledge of preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, vendor coordination, and facility operations.**
* **Experience handling housekeeping, landscaping, security coordination, and other outsourced services.**
* **Good manpower management, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.**
* **Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to emergencies.**
* **Proficiency in MS Excel, email, reporting, and maintenance tracking systems.**

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* **Experience managing premium residential communities, gated villa projects, luxury apartments, or large residential townships.**
* **Practical knowledge of electrical, plumbing, civil maintenance, water treatment systems, sewage treatment plants, DG sets, and other building utilities.**
* **Experience managing multiple vendors and a sizeable facility workforce.**
* **Strong ownership, accountability, and a hands-on approach to resolving operational issues.**
* **Resident-focused mindset with the ability to maintain high service standards.**

 **Qualifications**

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Timely completion of preventive and corrective maintenance.**
* **Reduction in recurring breakdowns and infrastructure complaints.**
* **Resident satisfaction and timely resolution of service requests.**
* **Cleanliness and upkeep of common areas and amenities.**
* **Vendor performance and service quality.**
* **Maintenance cost control and budget adherence.**
* **Staff productivity, attendance, and discipline.**
* **Safety compliance and emergency response effectiveness.**

 **Additional Information**

**We are looking for an experienced and proactive Facility Manager to oversee the overall maintenance, infrastructure, facilities, and day-to-day operations of a premium gated villa community.**

**The individual will be responsible for maintaining the community's infrastructure, common areas, utilities, landscaping, security coordination, housekeeping, and other essential services. The role involves managing facility staff, contractors, and service providers while ensuring high standards of maintenance, safety, cleanliness, and resident satisfaction.**

**The ideal candidate should have an engineering background, strong technical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage manpower, budgets, vendors, and day-to-day facility operations efficiently.**

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.  
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products and enterprise services. APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across Amazon’s transportation network. It ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.  
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock risk coverage across time zones.

* Process Expertise & Subject Matter Leadership — Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Surface Transportation processes and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for risk management within the assigned RoW geographies. Maintain subject matter expertise specific to job functions and general industry awareness to provide informed recommendations to leadership.

* Investigation Oversight & Triage — Oversee the investigation triage process — reviewing flagged cases from monitoring dashboards, determining root cause, validating operational justifications, identifying gaps in controls and processes, and managing escalations in consultation with legal where required.
* Technology Partnership & Monitoring Enhancement — Partner with automation and technology teams on dashboard enhancements, detection logic refinement, and false positive reduction to continuously improve monitoring accuracy, coverage, and program efficiencies.

Understand the business needs and workflows owned by your team including financial risk, controls, escalation paths, data sources, metrics, testing mechanisms, key dependencies, automation/tools, and risk-assessment methodologies.

Support risk reporting and risk-aware culture initiatives across RoW countries.

  
About the team

description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Production Manager to oversee end-to-end print production operations, including vendor management, cost negotiation, quality control, delivery coordination, and production documentation.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of print deliverables, from understanding client requirements and print specifications to coordinating with printers, monitoring production timelines, inspecting finished materials, and ensuring timely delivery. The ideal candidate must have strong knowledge of paper grades, GSM, printing techniques, finishing processes, binding, packaging, and quality standards, along with excellent negotiation and coordination skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Print Production Management**

* Manage end-to-end production of print materials, including scientific journals, medical education modules, calendars, brochures, booklets, newsletters, certificates, conference materials, and other marketing collaterals.
* Understand production briefs, artwork, quantities, dimensions, paper specifications, finishing requirements, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure all print jobs are executed according to approved specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor production schedules and proactively address delays or operational challenges.

**2. Vendor & Printer Management**

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and maintain relationships with printing vendors, paper suppliers, binding units, packaging vendors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate with printers at every stage, from quotation and proof approval to production, inspection, dispatch, and delivery.
* Obtain competitive quotations from multiple vendors and assess them based on cost, quality, reliability, and turnaround time.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms to achieve cost efficiencies.
* Maintain an updated vendor database, including capabilities, pricing, turnaround times, and performance records.

**3. Knowledge of Paper & Print Specifications**

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of paper types, grades, GSM, thickness, texture, opacity, and suitability for different print applications.
* Understand printing methods, including offset and digital printing, as well as lamination, UV coating, binding, folding, die-cutting, and other finishing techniques.
* Interpret technical specifications accurately, including dimensions, colour requirements, page counts, cover materials, binding styles, and packaging instructions.
* Verify that the paper and materials used by vendors match the approved specifications.
* Identify material substitutions or specification deviations before production and obtain approval wherever required.

**4. Costing & Budget Control**

* Prepare and evaluate print production estimates and quotations.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure competitive pricing without compromising quality.
* Compare actual production costs against approved budgets and identify opportunities for savings.
* Track cost variations arising from changes in quantities, paper specifications, artwork, finishing, or delivery requirements.
* Ensure all commercial commitments and additional costs are documented and approved.

**5. Quality Control & Inspection**

* Inspect samples, colour proofs, paper quality, print alignment, colour consistency, binding, finishing, and overall workmanship.
* Ensure the final output matches the approved artwork, specifications, sample, and purchase order.
* Identify defects such as incorrect GSM, colour variations, misprints, poor binding, damaged copies, and quantity shortages.
* Coordinate corrective actions, reprints, replacements, or vendor claims wherever necessary.
* Ensure that only approved, quality-checked materials are dispatched to clients or designated locations.

**6. Delivery & Logistics Coordination**

* Ensure timely delivery of all print materials to clients, offices, warehouses, event venues, and other designated locations.
* Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners for dispatch schedules, packaging, transportation, and delivery tracking.
* Monitor committed delivery dates and escalate potential delays well in advance.
* Verify delivered quantities against purchase orders and dispatch records.
* Ensure appropriate packaging, labelling, carton identification, and shipment documentation for every delivery.

**7. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain complete documentation for every print job, including:
* Production briefs and approved specifications.
* Vendor quotations and cost comparisons.
* Purchase orders and work orders.
* Artwork and proof approvals.
* Paper specifications and quality inspection reports.
* Delivery challans, e-way bills wherever applicable, invoices, and dispatch records.
* Delivery confirmations, shortage reports, and quality-related claims.
* Maintain a production tracker covering job status, vendor, quantities, costs, deadlines, and delivery status.
* Provide regular updates to management and internal teams on production progress, delays, costs, and pending deliveries.
* Ensure records are accurate, traceable, and readily available for audits and financial reconciliation.

**8. Internal Coordination**

* Work closely with client servicing, medical education, design, accounts, procurement, and operations teams.
* Clarify technical requirements before releasing jobs to printers.
* Ensure approved artwork, specifications, quantities, and delivery instructions are communicated clearly to vendors.
* Coordinate invoice verification against purchase orders, agreed pricing, and actual deliveries.
* Take ownership of production-related issues and ensure timely resolution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Printing Technology, Print Production, Graphic Arts, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant experience in print production, commercial printing, publishing, or production operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of paper quality, GSM, printing processes, binding, finishing, and packaging.
* Proven experience in vendor coordination, quotation evaluation, and cost negotiation.
* Strong understanding of production planning, quality control, inventory, and delivery management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and documentation, with the ability to maintain production trackers and cost comparison sheets.
* Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple jobs simultaneously.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time delivery rate of print jobs.
* Adherence to approved print specifications and quality standards.
* Cost savings achieved through vendor negotiations.
* Reduction in printing errors, reprints, wastage, and material shortages.
* Accuracy and completeness of production documentation.
* Vendor performance and responsiveness.
* Timely resolution of production and delivery issues.
* Adherence to approved budgets and purchase order values.

**Job Title:** EHS Operations Lead


**Job Purpose:**

* Support the regional sites in order to ensure that the unique needs of the regional sites are understood and incorporated into the regional EH\&S Program.
* Provide leadership and hands\-on assistance to ensure a safe, secure and compliant workplace across the region, delivering outstanding EH\&S work process implementation, EH\&S performance and sustaining the License to Operate.
* Work in close partnership with EH\&S Leadership to ensure all work processes and resources are in place and properly utilized and aligned.
* Partner with Hub Leaders, EH\&S Center of Excellence (CoE) and Site Leadership to ensure appropriate, consistent implementation and maintenance of EH\&S work processes, best practices and most effective technologies; coordinate, align priorities and initiatives; drive initiatives /projects; audit the effectiveness of work processes and implementation; analyze performance data for trends and identify opportunities for improvement across the region.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Leadership \& Planning**

* Align personal and team EH\&S objectives with platform, regional, functional and site strategies and priorities.
* Collaborate closely with the EH\&S Leader to ensure plans are well communicated and supported.
* Assist Regional EH\&S Leader with providing environmental, Industrial Hygiene (IH), health, safety, process safety/containment, and motor vehicle leadership, support and expertise to the regional sites in a manner that is compatible with local issues and culture.
* Measure functional performance against goals, client expectations and work with EH\&S Leader to develop improvement plans.

**Work Process / Improvement**

* Acts as the regional focal point for EH\&S disciplines (environmental, IH, health, safety, process safety/containment, and motor vehicle, etc.).
* Partner with Operations / R\&D to leverage resources in order to drive EH\&S performance by utilizing all available EH\&S tools and work processes.
* Leads EH\&S regional improvement projects and initiatives.
* Coaches teams and individuals on EH\&S related tasks / activities and acts as the area resource for related EH\&S information on procedures, guidelines and standards.
* Provides hands\-on environmental, IH, health, safety, process safety/containment, and motor vehicle, EH\&S work process, standards and procedure assistance for assigned sites as indicated.
* Analyze and evaluate site EH\&S performance to identify and implement opportunities for improvement
* Supports site compliance with Corporate EH\&S Standards and Governmental Regulatory Requirements. Provide local input to Regional EH\&S Leader for regulatory strategies and advocacy.
* Supports regional self\-assessment, audit, regulatory compliance corrective action completion \& validation.
* Supports regional corporate Process Safety and Containment work process implementation.
* Ensures all appropriate IH programs, monitoring and health surveillance requirements are met.
* Facilitates incident investigations and root cause analyses.
* Support contractor companies with site EHS standards compliance.
* Assist site responses to geographic and/or site EH\&S / Emergency Response \& Security (ER\&S) issues (in concert with ER\&S Team) and crises that affect operations consistent with site, business, and corporate "license to operate" requirements.
* Supports Operating Discipline Management System (ODMS) EH\&S elements for the regional area sites.
* Implement, utilize, maintain and promote EH\&S management systems (ODMS).
* Ensures minimization of local customization of EH\&S / ER\&S management systems whenever possible and leads / champions management system reviews in order to drive continuous improvement.
* Supports cost\-effective delivery of EH\&S and ER\&S systems.
* Provide expertise and support for site environmental stewardship, waste management and remediation (where indicated).
* Ensure delivery of required EH\&S training.
* Lead, support, participate in and/or provide data for EH\&S audits / assessments / compliance initiatives.
* Collects, analyzes, calculates and inputs data for EH\&S reporting as necessary.
* Performs field observations and safety interventions.
* Completes documentation and facilitates waste characterizations.
* Monitors EH\&S compliance tasks completion.
* Initiates and/or supports Site Management of Change (MoC) for EH\&S matters as necessary.
* Links to EH\&S CoE to obtain clear interpretations on site\-specific regulatory processes, regulations, laws and associated procedures.
* As required, participates in the environmental, IH, health and safety related reviews and project support.
* Aligns with Information Technology (IT) initiatives, updates, cyber security processes and tools.
**Networks**

* Participate in global cross\-functional networks and leadership teams.
* Participate and support regional EH\&S network in order to drive improvement and facilitate change.
* Support community initiatives and/or communication networks in order to sustain the companies' public 'License to Operate'.
* Support EH\&S advocacy initiatives including proactive value\-based participation in relevant regional area industry, professional associations and external networks per the direction of the Regional EH\&S Leader.
**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s/Masters degree in an applicable scientific discipline is required; Professional certification where applicable
* 10\+ years of relevant industry experience, knowledge and skills in a manufacturing / industrial environment
* Fluent in English
* Willing to travel 30\-50%

**Knowledge \& Skills:**

* Demonstrated knowledge of all EH\&S work processes, in addition to regional site operations and processes
* Demonstrated knowledge of all regulatory, permit, and company requirements for the region, including audit requirements
* Working knowledge of ER\&S work processes
* Facilitates development and leveraging of expertise
* Self\-motivated, independent thinker and performer
* Ability to manage multiple projects and set priorities
* Works methodically and meets required deadlines. Well organized with a demonstrated ability to work without supervision
* Excellent consultation, facilitation, and influencing skills
* Excellent inter\-personal relationship skills to all levels in an organization
* Demonstrated open and clear communications and processes for issue resolution
* Demonstrated leadership and mentoring skills
* Excellent English / local language verbal and written communication skills. Excellent training and presentation skills
* Ability to analyze technical writing and regulations
* Broad experience with computers including word processing, spreadsheets, database and training/presentation software
